verdict.rationale: Proxy routing is a fair question for a hosted headless-browser platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions proxies, IP rotation or residential/datacenter IP pools. The closest item, CAPTCHA and login handling (docs-10), is an adjacent anti-bot feature, not proxy routing, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks
